description: Compact live navigator preserves section access (REQ-027; C54, G22; R35, R98; AC-C54-01, AC-R027-01; JOURNEY-027). A3 TASK-108 (round 07; decision 2) carries it onto Round 7's compact SectionHeader bar (src/ui/workout-chrome.tsx): All sections with the N / M position over the collapsible, status-bearing jump list, with no section card, visible title, status line or structure badges; the section's name is each block's own MovementGroupHeader heading, so the navigator draws no second heading, and its Section N / M · status reading is visually hidden for assistive technology; the trigger keeps the one name All sections. Previous, Next and a jump move focus to the opened section's first card with a temporary tabindex, falling back to its heading (src/app/Workout.tsx). A jump records, corrects, clears and completes nothing, moves no section status and does not reset the session clock or a logged set. check-01 proves the component, the real route over in-memory doubles and the accepted gallery's navigator specimen (GallerySectionHeader) in jsdom; check-02 proves the route in the browser at 320 and 390 with a contained synthetic started session, touch, keyboard, reduced motion, a failed read and its retry and a reload, and the gallery specimen. Every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-027 --check check-01 -- npx vitest run src/ui/workout-chrome.test.tsx --passWithNoTests=false
